name: Atexxo iPhone Conversion
summary: A conversion service rather than a case: the iPhone is sent to Atexxo, modified internally and sealed in a flameproof (Ex db) enclosure certified for Zone 1/21.
imageAlt: iPhone in an Atexxo flameproof enclosure with the Ex mark

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb

os.name: iOS
os.version: Depends on the iPhone model inside

strengths: Keeps the iOS experience and apps
limitations: The phone is permanently modified; it is not a removable case
Phones must be sent to Atexxo for conversion
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
